description: This source file implements Bluetooth SDP (Service Discovery Protocol) client and server functionalities, including service discovery, attribute retrieval, and handling of SDP requests and responses within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth SDP client operations such as service discovery and attribute retrieval.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth SDP server operations, processing incoming SDP requests and generating responses.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers services and adds their attributes to a service tree.

methods.name: ServiceSearch
methods.description: Performs a service search for specified UUIDs and retrieves their handles.

methods.name: ServiceAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves attributes for a specific service handle.

methods.name: ServiceSearchAttribute
methods.description: Performs a combined service search and attribute retrieval for specified UUIDs.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes a command and processes the payload with an inspector callback.

methods.name: OnServiceSearchRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming Service Search requests on the server side.

methods.name: OnServiceAttributeRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming Service Attribute requests on the server side.

methods.name: OnServiceSearchAttributeRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming Service Search Attribute requests on the server side.
